HSCL in last few months made multiple attempts to shoot up & failed so not a very clean mover imho
no reco to buy/sell, pls do your own research

however Q1 FY27 results were ok (not out of the world) & stock has corrected 15% already

although on daily chart looks like a smooth 60% run up, every time you got in, SL would have hit soon after!
Judging the results & also how much the price has moved pre earnings helps you take calls post earnings
